_comments: THE DAILY FORECAST SNAPSHOT (#40). Its own file, for the same coordination reason as
`.sales-forecast-actions.json`: MetadataSync reads every dot-json in the directory, so two sessions
adding a file each conflict on nothing.
DAILY, NOT HOURLY, and that is the one value that differs in spirit from the activity sync rather
than in detail. A forecast snapshot is a measurement of a period, and its whole value is comparing
one day's answer to the next — 'what did we think on the 1st'. Twenty-four captures a day would be
twenty-four rows saying almost the same thing, and the series a human reads would be noise. 02:00
UTC puts it after the close of business in every timezone Blue Cypress sells in, so a day's deals
are in before the day is measured.
The job is also idempotent within a day by design, not just by cadence: the writer SKIPS a grain
already captured today rather than adding a second capture. So a manual run, a catch-up run and the
scheduled run cannot between them turn one day into three data points.
· ConcurrencyMode `Skip` — two concurrent captures would both read an empty guard and both write.
· MissedRunPolicy `RunOnce` — catching up a week of missed days would capture TODAY's numbers seven
times and label them as seven days. That is worse than the gap it is trying to fill: a gap is
visibly missing, whereas seven identical rows look like a week of flat forecast.
· RunImmediatelyIfNeverRun `false` — a first deployment should not capture a period nobody has
looked at yet, and there is no source registered to capture from anyway.
WHY IT IS SAFE TO SHIP `Active`: the forecast source factory defaults to NULL, so the run reports
NO_SOURCE and writes nothing until somebody registers a query-backed source. See the note in
`.sales-forecast-actions.json` for why an invented forecast number is the worst thing this could do.

fields.Name: Sales — Forecast Snapshot (daily)
fields.Description: Captures ForecastSnapshot rows for the current period from the sales forecast queries. Writes nothing until a forecast source is registered; skips any grain already captured today.
